Bars & Brownies: Bake one pan, cut it into squares.
Cakes & Loaves: One batter, one tin, slices all week.
Custards & Puddings: Temper eggs, chill it, and pudding waits in the fridge.
Breads: Mix, knead, let it rise, bake. Flour and water into a loaf.
Flatbreads & Pancakes: Roll a dough or pour a batter onto a hot pan.
Soups: Fill one pot in an hour, eat from it for two days.
Stews & Braises: Brown it, cover it, and let the oven take care of Sunday.
Rice, Beans & Grains: The pot that carries the rest of dinner.
Sauces & Gravies: Simmer what turns pasta, rice or a roast into dinner.
Dressings & Dips: Blend a jar on Sunday and eat better salads all week.
Spice Blends & Marinades: Mix one jar now, season a month of dinners.
